description:
Full-text search over the official AGILEX product documentation.

        Use this first for any question about AGILEX hardware: pinouts, CAN
        protocol details, baud rate, firmware upgrade, error codes, LED/beep
        meanings, installation, calibration, SDK usage.

        Args:
            query: Chinese or English keywords. Include the product name
                (piper / pika / nero / ranger / limo / scout / bunker / hunter /
                tracer / umr) plus the concept, e.g. "piper CAN 波特率".
            limit: 1-25 results, default 8.
            space: optional space slug or name fragment to narrow the search,
                e.g. "agx-chassis-manual-cn-en" or "底盘使用手册".

        Returns JSON: {query, count, results:[{doc_id,title,space,url,score,chars,snippet}]}.
        ``count`` is the number of results in this reply (0-``limit``). Pages whose
        title carries 【未发】/【暂不对外】 are not offered for reading and never
        appear here — they are unpublished, not missing.
        ``doc_id`` is what ``get_doc`` expects.
name: search_docs
